chapterInfo.content:
1
Amanaman no ateatea
1 # Amos 7.14; 2 Ah 15.1; 14.23; Sak 14.5 Amos a ɔwɔ Tekoa nnwanyɛnfoɔ mu nsɛm a ɔhunuu no n’ani soɔ, Israel ho, ɛwɔ Yudahene Usia berɛ soɔ ne Israelhene Yeroboam a ɔyɛ Yoas ba berɛ soɔ, mfeɛ mmienu ansa na asasewosoɔ no reba nie.
2 # Yer 25.30; Yoel 3.16 Na ɔse:
AWURADE firi Sion bobom,
na ɔfiri Yerusalem ma ne nne so;
na nnwanhwɛfoɔ adidibea no atwintwam,
na Karmel atifi akusa.
3 # Yes 17.1-3 Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Damasko amumuyɛ ntoatoasoɔ nti
merennane n’asotwe no,
sɛ wɔde dadeɛ ayuporeɛadeɛ
dwerɛɛ Gilead nti.
4Na mɛto Hasael fie mu gya,
na ahye Ben-hadad aban denden no.
5 # 2 Ah 16.9 Na mɛbubu Damasko pono akyiri adaban,
na matwa wɔn a wɔte Awen bonhwa mu afiri hɔ,
ne ɔhempomakurani no afiri Bet-eden;
na wɔbɛtu Siria man akɔ Kir,
AWURADE na ɔseɛ.
6 # 2 Be 28.17-18; Yer 47.1 Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Gasa amumuyɛ ntoatoasoɔ nti
merennane n’asotwe no,
sɛ wɔtuu atukɔfoɔ ɔman mu
kɔɔ sɛ wɔde wɔn rekɔhyɛ Edom nsa nti.
7Na mɛto Gasa fasuo mu gya,
na ahye n’aban denden no;
8na mɛtwa emufoɔ afiri Asdod
ne ahempomakurani afiri Askelon,
na mɛdane me nsa atia Ekron,
na Filistifoɔ nkaeɛ ayera,
AWURADE Nyankopɔn na ɔseɛ.
9 # Yes 23; Yoel 3.4; 1 Ah 5.12 Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Tiro amumuyɛ ntoatoasoɔ nti
merennane n’asotwe no,
sɛ wɔde atukɔfoɔ ɔman mu hyɛɛ Edom nsa,
na wɔankae anuanom apam no nti.
10Na mɛto Tiro fasuo mu gya,
na ahye n’aban denden no.
11 # Yer 49.7; Deut 23.7; Oba 10 Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Edom amumuyɛ ntoatoasoɔ nti
merennane n’asotwe no,
sɛ ɔde afena tii ne nua,
na ne yam anhyehye no,
na n’abufuo sɛee adeɛ ara
na ɔyɛɛ n’abohuro no so adeɛ daa nti.
12Na mɛto Teman mu gya,
na ahye Bosra aban denden no.
13 # Yer 49.1-6 Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie:
Amonfoɔ amumuyɛ ntoatoasoɔ nti
merennane wɔn asotwe no,
sɛ wɔgu so retrɛ w’ahyeɛ mu no,
wɔpaepaee mpo Gilead anyinsɛnfoɔ mu,
14na mɛsɔ Raba fasuo mu gya,
na ahye n’aban denden no,
na wɔbɛte ɔko mu gyegyeegye,
na ɔko no bɛyɛ den sɛ ahumtuo da no kirididibɔ mu.
15Na wɔn hene bɛkɔ otukorɔ mu,
ɔno ne ne mmapɔmma bɛbom akɔ,
AWURADE na ɔseɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
